# ko.io

> Source-traced SEC & market data for AI agents and quants. 100M+ records:
> 13F institutional holdings (2013→today, family-consolidated), insider
> trades (Forms 3/4/5), Congress trading, crypto ETF exposure, Form 144,
> fails-to-deliver, Reg SHO, stock prices & financials, US macro, and a
> white-labeled SEC EDGAR filings gateway. Served over MCP and REST.

Base REST URL: https://api.ko.io (paths start with /api/v1/)
MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless): https://mcp.ko.io/mcp
Auth (REST): Authorization: Bearer ko_live_...  |  keyless demo: append ?demo=true
Auth (MCP): Authorization: Bearer header, or ?api_key= on the URL; keyless = demo mode
Free key: 200 calls/day, no credit card — https://ko.io/console
Response envelope (most endpoints): {"data": ..., "meta": {total_count, page, per_page, truncated?, upgrade_hint?}}; a few nest pagination inside data (e.g. stock-holders)
Errors: {"error": {"code": "PLAN_REQUIRED" | "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED" | ..., "message": "..."}}

## Connect an MCP client

- Claude Code: claude mcp add ko-sec-data --transport http https://mcp.ko.io/mcp
- Claude Desktop: {"mcpServers": {"ko-sec-data": {"type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.ko.io/mcp"}}}
- Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json): {"mcpServers": {"ko-sec-data": {"url": "https://mcp.ko.io/mcp"}}}
- Codex CLI: codex mcp add ko-sec-data --url https://mcp.ko.io/mcp
- stdio-only clients: npx -y @ko-io/mcp-sec-data (env KO_API_KEY)

## MCP tools (24)

- search(query, limit): universal search across institutions, stocks, Congress members
- get_institution_holdings(institution, page, limit): 13F holdings by CIK or fuzzy name
- list_institutions(search, page, limit): 13F filers ranked by portfolio value
- get_stock_profile(ticker): company info + ownership summary
- get_stock_holders(ticker, page, limit): institutional holders of a ticker
- get_stock_activity(ticker, quarters): institutional accumulation/distribution trend
- get_stock_price(ticker, period, series, limit): daily OHLCV
- get_stock_financials(ticker, period_type, limit): XBRL-derived statements
- get_insider_trades(ticker, executive_cik, limit): Form 3/4/5 transactions
- list_insider_traders(search, role, page, limit): insiders directory
- get_congress_trades(chamber, party, ticker, state, search, sort, page, limit)
- get_congress_member(member, page, limit): one member's trades by slug
- get_form144_notices(ticker, insider_cik, limit): planned insider sales
- get_crypto_exposure(): market-wide institutional spot-BTC-ETF exposure
- get_crypto_holders(product, page, limit): institutions holding BTC ETFs
- get_crypto_holder(institution): one institution's crypto exposure
- sec_list_filings(cik, form_type, from, to, limit): EDGAR filings list
- sec_get_filing_index(cik, accession_no): files inside a filing
- sec_get_filing_document(cik, accession_no, file, include_excerpt): document + signed link
- get_ftd_data(ticker, days): SEC fails-to-deliver
- get_treasury_yields(days) [Pro]
- get_fed_rates(days) [Pro]
- get_economic_indicators(category, days) [Pro]
- get_financial_stress(days) [Pro]

## Key REST endpoints

- /api/v1/institutions?search=&category=&page=&per_page=
- /api/v1/institutions/{cik} · /api/v1/institutions/{cik}/similar
- /api/v1/holdings/{cik}?quarter=&ticker=&action=&type=quarters
- /api/v1/institution-activity/{cik}
- /api/v1/stocks?search=&sector= · /api/v1/stocks/{ticker}
- /api/v1/stock-price/{ticker}?days=&start_date=&end_date=
- /api/v1/stock-holders/{ticker}?quarter=&type=activity&quarters=
- /api/v1/stocks/{ticker}/financials · /financials/historical
- /api/v1/insider-trades?ticker=&role= · /api/v1/insider/{cik}/transactions
- /api/v1/executive-trades/{ticker}
- /api/v1/congress-trades?ticker=&chamber=&party=&sort=
- /api/v1/congress-trades/{member-slug} · /stock/{ticker}
- /api/v1/crypto/exposure-summary · /institutional-holders?product= · /holder/{cik}
- /api/v1/form144-notices?ticker=&cik=
- /api/v1/sec/ftd?ticker=&days= · /api/v1/reg-sho-threshold?symbol=
- /api/v1/treasury/yields [Pro] · /api/v1/fed/rates [Pro]
- /api/v1/economic/indicators [Pro] · /api/v1/stress/ofr [Pro]
- /api/v1/filings/{cik}?form=&from=&to= · /{accession} · /{accession}/share
- /api/v1/search?q=

## SDKs

- Python: pip install ko-edgar — from ko_edgar import KoClient; KoClient().stocks.holders("NVDA")
- TypeScript: npm install @ko-io/sdk — new KoClient().congress.trades({sort: "recent"})
- OpenAPI spec: https://ko.io/openapi.yaml

- REST reference: https://ko.io/docs
